question: What is the canonical remaining scope for #54397 now that rename, pin, archive, and search slices landed on main?
rationale: The unsolved pieces define cross-surface product semantics and persisted session metadata/import/export behavior, which cannot be safely inferred from code alone.

options.title: Keep umbrella and stage scope
options.body: Keep #54397 open as the canonical tracker, document the staged remaining pieces, and require future PRs to reuse the existing sessions.list/create/patch/delete contracts where possible.

options.title: Split into narrower canonical issues
options.body: Create separate canonical issues for CLI lifecycle, TUI management, metadata/tags, and import/export, then close this umbrella only after those references exist.

options.title: Treat current main as enough
options.body: Close the umbrella as satisfied by #98510 and related rename work, accepting that tags, import/export, full TUI/CLI management, and topic metadata remain out of scope.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and stage scope
recommendation.body: Keep #54397 open as the canonical tracker, document the staged remaining pieces, and require future PRs to reuse the existing sessions.list/create/patch/delete contracts where possible.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent broad session thread management implementation and TUI session lifecycle work closest to the product decision.
